meta.title: tidy-one — One tidy, private memory for all your AI agents
meta.description: Your documents, photos, videos and cloud apps in one private search index, built on your own devices. Originals stay put, and every AI agent searches it through MCP. Coming in 2026.
meta.og_title: tidy-one — Scattered memory, tidied into one
meta.og_description: A private memory index shared by all your AI agents. Open source, self-hosted, with Korean-first search. Coming soon.
meta.og_image_alt: Scattered sage pixels settling into an ordered grid

hero.statement: A private memory index |shared by all |your AI agents
hero.sub: Your documents, photos, videos and cloud apps, indexed on your own devices and searchable in one place. Originals stay where they are, and every agent you use searches it all through MCP.
hero.cta_primary_hint: On GitHub, choose Watch → Custom → Releases to hear when the first version ships.

problem.label: Scattered memory
problem.heading: Your memory is |all there. ||Just in |too many places.
problem.p1: Meeting recordings sit in Plaud, plans in Notion, a contract in some folder on your laptop, photos on your phone. When you need something, you first have to remember where you put it.
problem.p2: Your AI agents are no better off. Claude Code remembers per folder, the phone app keeps its own notes, and the browser agent keeps yet another set. None of them know what the others know, so you explain the same things again and again.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Wherever it lives. ||Whatever it is. ||Whoever asks.

devices.title: Across your devices
devices.body: A lightweight indexing agent runs quietly on your Mac and Windows PC. On your iPhone, you search the same index.

formats.title: In any format
formats.body: PDF, Office and HWP documents, photos and videos, plus your work in Notion, Google Drive, Gmail, Plaud and Slack.

search.title: Korean-first search
search.body: KURE-v1 embeddings and Kiwi morphological search find things by meaning, not just matching words. Image vectors make what's in your photos searchable, too.

agents.title: Any agent, via MCP
agents.body: Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai on the web and iOS, and browser agents all search through the same MCP endpoint.

step1.title: Index on your device
step1.body: Files are read, parsed and turned into vectors right where they live.

step2.title: Send only excerpts and vectors
step2.body: Short excerpts and vectors go to a small server you run yourself, a $24/month VPS. Originals never do.

step3.title: Search from any agent
step3.body: Ask from Claude Code at your desk or claude.ai on your phone. The answer comes from the same index.

originals.title: Originals stay on device
originals.body: Your server keeps only the short excerpts and vectors that search needs.

secrets.title: Secrets never leave
secrets.body: Files holding passwords, API keys or private keys never leave your device, not even as excerpts.

open.title: Self-hosted, open source
open.body: You run the server, and the code is MIT-licensed, so you can check exactly what goes where.

works_with.label: Works with
works_with.note: Plus any other client that speaks MCP.
works_with.disclaimer: tidy-one is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with any of the services above.

status.label: Roadmap
status.heading: Where things stand.
status.note: First release in 2026. The order may change.
